summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including the addition of relative paths to the v4 spec and improvements to the REST catalog. A new static website has been created to consolidate design documents and discussions, while the community is also considering changes to the HostnameVerificationPolicy in TLSConfigurer.
highlights: Discussion on removing Spark 3.4 from integration work
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on adding 'labels' field to LoadTableResponse in REST Catalog
Community exploring efficient column updates in Iceberg
